verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs describe 150+ no-code connectors for consolidating cross-system data, live ERP data, a synced single source of truth, and AI agents that continuously map new accounts and vendors from source data. Together these imply that accounting actuals flow in automatically without manual exports, but QuickBooks, Xero, and NetSuite are never named, and actuals landing in the model is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite connector documentation, a description of the sync cadence for actuals into models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
